tools.name: inspect_store
tools.description: Detects whether a store runs Shopify or WooCommerce and whether its public catalog can be read, and returns its currency and how many products it publishes. Call it first on an unknown store: it is cheap, and every other tool needs a readable store. Light read: costs 0.2 credit.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists the products of a Shopify or WooCommerce store, a page at a time, in a compact shape: title, URL, vendor, type, price range, sale price, currency, in stock, variant count, main image. Pass a collection or category page URL, or 'collection', to list only that part. Use 'next_page' from the answ

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one product of a Shopify or WooCommerce store in full: every variant with its options, SKU, barcode (GTIN/UPC/EAN, Shopify), price and sale price, stock where the store publishes it, weight in grams; options, images with alt text, description as plain text, tags, rating (WooCommerce). tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches one Shopify or WooCommerce store for products matching a keyword, through the store's own public search, and returns the matches in the same compact shape as list_products. Up to 10 results on Shopify (its search limit), up to 20 on WooCommerce. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Returns your current plan, remaining credit balance and call volume over the last 30 days. Free to call.
